reason: I already stop at the supermarket on my way home from work, so this saves me nothing in time, and $2 a bag is real money when every dollar counts. I would not trust that the pooling saves more than the fee.
objection: Another fee on top of my groceries. I pass Spinneys and Tawfeer MAX anyway, so I would be paying $2 just to have someone else do what I already do, and I have no proof the bulk prices come out lower than the fee.
would_change_my_mind: Clear proof, with a real receipt, that my usual basket costs more than $2 less than when I buy it myself, or no fee at all on the first few orders.
